Austria / Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph

pepper-collection

A collection of private chalets and apartments in Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph on the Arlberg, for families and friends. Some sit right on the slopes; The Barn comes with a butler and a private chef.

Plan a stay hereAbout Lech am Arlberg
01 / 05

In short

What to know.

  • Chalet Mimi in Oberlech: ski-in and ski-out in winter, for up to 14 guests
  • The Barn in Oberlech: 1,000 m², with a 24/7 butler and a private chef
  • Skyfall in St. Christoph: four residences that connect, for up to 21 guests together
  • Arla Luxury Home on the Schlegelkopf slope, for groups of 2 to 10

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For families and groups who want a private house on the Arlberg, with the service of a hotel when they want it.

Good to know.

Each house is provided by pepper-collection. EverFlow arranges your stay; your contract is with the provider.

For hotel and chalet stays we arrange, we may receive a commission from the provider.

  • peppercollection.com
